title: Workflow Architecture
description: The multi-agent design the architect produces and the reviewer refines, before it is written out as a .workflow.yaml. Constrained to what the registry and the execution graph will actually accept, so a design that could not be installed fails here rather than at install time.

workflow_id.description: Kebab-case. The registry rejects anything else, and the filename stem must equal it.

agents.description: At least one, or there is no workflow to write.

id.description: Kebab-case, and the name of the .agent.md file that must accompany it.

stage.description: Unique within the workflow. This is what depends_on refers to — not the agent id.

depends_on.description: Stage names that must finish first. Empty or absent means the stage is ready immediately.

optional.description: Whether a failure here is survivable.

when.description: How this stage reacts to its dependencies' outcomes.
